tuto.title: Tutorial
game.chute.desc: Jump from ever higher and land in the boxes. Aim, do tricks and nail your landing!
game.choregraphie.desc: A choreographed fight, in rhythm. Tap at the right time to chain strikes, blocks and dodges.
game.esquive.desc: Run non-stop across the set. Switch lanes, jump and slide to avoid the obstacles.
game.voiture.desc: Ramp jumps, barrel rolls and drifts. Chain car stunts and stop right on your mark.
tuto.chute.5.title: 3. Back position!
tuto.chute.5.body: At the end, a ring closes in on you. Tap on the right when it reaches the pink band to land on your back. The longer you wait, the bigger the bonus. Otherwise, the game is over.
tuto.chute.5.keys: At the end, a ring closes in on you. Press Space when it reaches the pink band to land on your back. The longer you wait, the bigger the bonus. Otherwise, the game is over.
tuto.chute.1.title: 1. Aim for the boxes
tuto.chute.1.body: The cursor goes back and forth on the bar. Tap when it is in the colour: once for direction, once for power. Pink = perfect.
tuto.chute.2.title: With wind
tuto.chute.2.body: Do not aim at the target: stop the cursor on the blue mark. The wind will push you onto the boxes.
tuto.chute.3.title: 2. Survive the fall!
tuto.chute.3.body: During the fall, swipe with your left thumb to move your performer. Avoid the red zones: an obstacle will pass there. Go through the green circles: a ring of fire, +500 points.
tuto.chute.3.keys: During the fall, move your performer with the arrow keys. Avoid the red zones: an obstacle will pass there. Go through the green circles: a ring of fire, +500 points.
tuto.chute.4.title: Do tricks
tuto.chute.4.body: Swipe with your right thumb: up or down for a flip, sideways for a twist. Chain them for a combo that multiplies your points. If an obstacle hits you, the current combo is lost.
tuto.chute.4.keys: W and S keys for a flip, A and D for a twist. Chain them for a combo that multiplies your points. If an obstacle hits you, the current combo is lost.
install.ios.1: In Safari, tap the Share button (at the bottom of the screen, sometimes under the three dots).
install.ios.2: Scroll down and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
install.ios.3: Tap Add, at the top right. Done!
install.android.1: In Chrome, open the menu (the three dots, at the top right).
install.android.2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
install.inapp.1: You are in an app's browser (Instagram for example). Tap the three dots, at the top right.
install.inapp.3: The game opens in your browser: then follow the steps to install it.
